quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only," what should you do?

options.text: Go in the direction the arrow shows.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go in the direction the arrow shows.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are near a school or school crossing.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic going both ways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at busy intersections with heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right into your lane. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs are used for work zones. Stay alert when you see orange signs, cones, or barrels. This sign means a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The highest speed you can drive under normal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed you can drive under normal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the maximum speed limit for that road. You can drive slower if conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is unsafe and illegal to make a right turn here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing downward means you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you must stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging onto the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular yellow sign with black lettering means no passing is allowed. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where passing is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Get ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. Only proceed when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming hazards. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide service information. They show locations of rest areas, food, gas stations, hospitals, and other motorist services.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. You may see changes in traffic direction, steep downgrades, or other dangerous conditions that need your attention.

questions.question: When displayed on a vehicle's rear, this sign indicates:

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, and farm equipment may display this sign. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic from the right will merge into your lane.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle means:
questions.explanation: Farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to warn other drivers.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: These signs tell you that you are near a school. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign shows a crosswalk ahead. Stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that another road crosses ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign shows the recommended safe speed for the curve ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided by an island or barrier.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that turning right or left when the signal is red is not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: This sign means the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a reverse curve. The road will curve right, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road will be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic laws you must follow. When you see this sign, drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show important rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane. Keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you to watch for a side road that crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What message is on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Turn left only on a green arrow.
Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Wait for the solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A sign that says "yield" means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass first. Then you can proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or gets narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or gets narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road ahead will change direction or become narrower. You may see this sign on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers that traffic signals are at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign shows you are in or near a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells drivers that road work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs show you are in or approaching a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits near schools.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers of a winding road coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to construction.
The road ahead turns at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign tells drivers to slow down and prepare for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Move left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Move left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They tell you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns that lanes are reducing and you must merge left.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane splits into two directions. You may turn left or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The tallest vehicle allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (for example, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. Construction areas are shown with orange warning signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to upcoming situations. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of an intersection so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to drive safely around these curves.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal picture warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
Wait until it turns green to proceed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep a steady speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is near. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to situations you might not see right away. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path first. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before proceeding.
Let traffic on the road ahead pass before you enter or cross.
Keep a steady speed and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road ahead pass before you enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way highway where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Get ready to stop because a railroad crossing is ahead.
Always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready to stop because a railroad crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming. Look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this signal, what should you do?

options.text: Turn as long as you yield to other drivers.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a complete stop and stay stopped while the red arrow is on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and stay stopped while the red arrow is on.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop completely. Do not turn. Stay stopped as long as the red arrow is showing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White signs show rules you must obey. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at any time.

questions.question: What is this orange triangle symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see it on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to possible hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and be careful to avoid crashes and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn left where this sign is posted. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that right turns are not allowed in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing down is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities who have the proper license plate or parking placard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What do orange signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.
